messages:
Lina (sec): heads-up — after the eu mtls cert rotation this morning, we've got intermittent handshake failures and some KMS AccessDenied on cert unwraps in eu-central-1. Observability alerted.
Marco (eng-infra): can you drop a log snippet and which principal is failing?
Ruth (oncall): sample:
```
2026-03-26T04:21:11Z proxy-eu-2 ERROR handshake: cert_unwrap failed: KMSAccessDenied arn:aws:kms:eu-central-1:444444:key/9a8b7c
principal=arn:aws:sts::444444:assumed-role/svc-proxy-eu/session-312 req=trace-88f
```
Ibrahim (sre): quick triage — looks like the new RBAC constraint removed the delegate role used by the rotation job. When rotation job rewrapped the new certs, the proxy pods tried to decrypt and got denied.
Lina (sec): PR 4599 tightened iam:AssumeRole mapping to serviceaccounts; sounds like the rotation job was still assuming the old role. Two paths: reintroduce a scoped assume-role for the rotation job OR update the key policy to include the new serviceaccount-based principal.
Marco (eng-infra): immediate mitigation: apply a 30m emergency key-policy grant scoped to the assumed-role arn and region, and restart a small canary of proxies. Also, increase CERT_CACHE_TTL from 120s to 600s so pods can serve cached certs while we stabilize.
Ruth (oncall): running the canary now. deploy-bot: rolling proxy-eu canary v5.2.0 -> v5.2.1 (2/2 updated).
rotate-bot: rotation job 2026-03-26T04:18 committed new cert chain for tenant-group-3.
Marco (eng-infra): temp key policy snippet applied (terraform override, expires in 30m). recorded in infra-audit with note: "emergency: rotation RBAC fallout".
audit-bot: alert logged: keystore.unwrap_error.rate 0.14 @ 2026-03-26T04:22:00Z — incident inc-20260326-eu-mtls created.
Ibrahim (sre): after canary restart and temp grant, handshake errors dropped to baseline. We'll keep the cache bump for 1h and then revert once stable.
Lina (sec): compliance asks: any emergency grants must have an expiry, reason, and correlated incident id in the audit record. Also need logs to include assumed_role_arn, kms_key_id, request_id, and incident_id tag for correlation.
Marco (eng-infra): agreed. Long term fixes: (1) update key policy to allow kms:Decrypt for the new federated principal using `kms:ViaService` + `aws:RequestedRegion` condition; (2) modify rotation job to use the new serviceaccount identity (or add a scoped assume-role back); (3) add unit/integration tests that simulate assume-role and serviceaccount flows during RBAC rollouts.
Ruth (oncall): adding alert: keystore.unwrap_fail > 5% over 5m -> page oncall. Also adding runbook note: if rotation job identity changes, validate key-policy mapping before rolling certs.
Ibrahim (sre): I'll prepare a short postmortem draft with timeline, IAM diffs, and sample audit logs. Scheduling incident review tomorrow.
Lina (sec): assigning INC-6377 to track RCA + compliance artifacts. thanks team — ping here if anything flares.
